title: Return a closed tour when edge weights are negative
summary: The negative-weight triangle produced a closed tour of weight −6. The four-vertex tour visited every vertex once and its reported weight equaled the sum along the returned path.

change.description: Let the farthest-insertion heuristic select a finite negative edge and a finite negative distance to the current tour.

notes: The positive edge allows initialization and leaves only negative candidates for expansion. Public graph readback checks the reported tour independently.
